detail: Full summary: Sqlite backend is full-fidelity for decision records: the data column holds JSON.stringify of the whole Decision object (sqlite-stores.ts:178) and RecordExporter mirrors that same object, so exported JSON never drops fields like rationale_source on create or updateStatus round-trips
